Question ID: SPEECH_U06_L04_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.RES.01

Professional briefing item 1: Which choice best uses research to support a concise professional recommendation?

answer.text: A. Use a broad question that does not guide evidence

feedback.text: This choice is incomplete because it does not support a clear professional or multimedia communication purpose.

answer.text: B. Choose evidence because it sounds impressive

feedback.text: This answer may sound related, but it does not fully connect evidence, media, audience, and spoken explanation.

answer.text: C. Write a focused research question that guides evidence

feedback.text: Correct. This choice supports professional communication by connecting clear purpose, source support, media choices, and audience understanding.

answer.text: D. Include every source detail without explaining it

feedback.text: This choice weakens communication because it does not help the audience understand the professional message.
